name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Burning Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If at least 1 of them is heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavor:
This Pokémon sets the bone it holds
on fire and dances through the night
as a way to mourn its fallen allies.
